latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Online Video skill — edit and export YouTube-ready videos in the cloud.

- Edit MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB for YouTube publishing with 1080p MP4 export.
- Automatic cloud GPU processing; typical turnaround is 1-2 minutes per video.
- Handles actions like upload, trim, add subtitles, preview timeline, export, and check credits or project state.
- Anonymous users granted free 7-day tokens with 100 credits.
- Clear error handling for token, file support, quota, or subscription issues.
- Designed for easy, GUI-style workflows via chat commands.
